mapSource: Geofabrik Georgia country extract, with OpenStreetMap France mirror as build-time fallback
notes: The binary map is generated by GitHub Actions from a verified Georgia-country OpenStreetMap PBF. Geofabrik is primary; the OpenStreetMap France mirror is the build-time fallback. The map is checked against the provider MD5, written with Mapsforge Map Writer type=hd, then packaged inside the APK. The source ZIP does not contain generated binary map assets. Name variants are included only where available in OSM; no automatic translation is performed. The app independently enables English, Russian and Georgian map-label readers and combines enabled variants through Mapsforge MultiMapDataStore; visual label-collision and performance validation on physical devices remains pending. Map Writer receives explicit bbox=41.00,39.95,43.65,46.80 because the CI PBF mirror did not expose a usable bbox in its header. POI SQLite is generated from the exact same verified PBF and includes named nodes, closed ways and multipolygon relations. Relation extraction is implemented; full-country deduplication and search relevance review remain pending. Search indexes public address, phone, website, opening_hours, cuisine, wheelchair, internet_access, operator and brand tags when present; these are source values and are not treated as real-time opening or availability status. The optional road graph includes car, motorcycle, 4x4, bicycle and foot access profiles. Copernicus GLO-90 elevation tiles and their manifest are packaged in the APK; absent public cells are explicitly recorded and are not treated as zero elevation. A local eight-item pre-ride safety checklist is stored only in private app preferences and does not require network access.
languageCoverage: Only OSM name variants present in source data are written; no automatic translation.
mapBuildPipeline: GitHub Actions: cached verified country OSM PBF -> Mapsforge map + POI database + optional road graph + Copernicus GLO-90 DEM -> APK assets

poiDatabase.search: Local substring search across default, English, Russian and Georgian names when present, categories, subcategories, addresses and selected public contact/business tags; route-corridor search is available along a planned route; no network required.
poiDatabase.geometryCoverage: OSM nodes, closed ways and multipolygon relations; full-country duplicate and coverage validation remains pending.
poiDatabase.nameCoverage: Only name variants present in OSM are stored; missing variants are not automatically translated.
poiDatabase.source: Same verified country OSM PBF as the Mapsforge map.

poiSearchCapabilities: route-corridor POI search ordered along the planned route
